title: Americans Are Turning to AI for Credit Help—But Is It Working?

content_html:
TheStreet

Thu, July 30, 2026 at 1:16 AM PDT

Gen Z debt is rising, credit counseling demand is at a 10-year high, and many people are discovering that debt consolidation loans don't always stop the cycle. In this episode, Ted Rossman, Money Management International breaks down what's driving the surge in debt management plan enrollments and counseling sessions—and what you can do to regain control of your finances before balances climb back up.

Z 世代的债务不断上升，信贷咨询需求达到 10 年来的最高水平，许多人发现债务合并贷款并不总是能阻止这个循环。 在本集中，资金管理国际公司的泰德·罗斯曼 (Ted Rossman) 详细分析了推动债务管理计划注册和咨询会议激增的原因，以及在余额回升之前您可以采取哪些措施来重新控制自己的财务状况。
